# The Name Generators

> Free online name generators for fantasy characters, places, organisations, objects and more: for D&D and other tabletop games, writing, gaming, worldbuilding, music projects and businesses. Each generator page has the generator, example names and an article on the naming conventions behind them.

Names are free to use, no credit needed. If you're naming a business, brand, band or product, check the name isn't already taken or trademarked first.

Made by Rich: https://thenamegenerators.com/about.html

## Blogs & Brands

- [Blog Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/blog-name-generator.html): Blog name ideas by topic, from food and travel to books, gardening and money: Crumbs & Butter, Notes from the Potting Shed, One More Chapter.
- [Brand Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/brand-name-generator.html): Brand and product names sorted by industry and feel, from tech and luxury to food, fashion and outdoor, as one word or with a product word (Juniper Botanicals).
- [YouTube Channel Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/youtube-channel-name-generator.html): YouTube channel names by topic (gaming, cooking, tech, travel, music) in the shapes that work on the platform, plus how to check the handle is free.
- [Podcast Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/podcast-name-generator.html): Podcast names that say what the show is like: an adjective and a format (The Curious Hour), or a phrase with personality, plus how to check a name is free.
- [Gamertag Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/gamertag-generator.html): Gamertags and usernames for Xbox, PlayStation, Discord, Steam and social media: cool, funny, fantasy or short, with your own word or name mixed in if you like.

## Events

- [Event Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/event-name-generator.html): Names for parties, festivals, gigs, fundraisers, tournaments, quiz nights, hen and stag dos and work events, plus how to check a name is free.

## Halloween

- [Scarecrow Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/scarecrow-name-generator.html): Scarecrow names for the garden, the allotment, a village scarecrow festival or a scary story: folksy names like Old Tom Turnip, or creepy ones like the Hollow Man of Barley Rise.
- [Mummy Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/mummy-name-generator.html): Mummy names from real Ancient Egyptian names, royal and everyday, with what each one means and a title, from Royal Scribe to Keeper of the Western Tombs.
- [Horror Movie Title Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/horror-movie-title-generator.html): Horror film titles for scripts, stories, student films and party games: hauntings, slashers, folk horror, creatures, possession and found footage.
- [Skeleton Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/skeleton-name-generator.html): Skeleton names for Halloween decorations, parties and games: funny bone puns like Patella Pete and Sir Femur, or grim skeleton lords and barrow kings.
- [Monster Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/monster-name-generator.html): Monster names for stories, games and Halloween: grim beasts from under the bed, the swamp, the sea and the mountains, or funny, friendly monsters for kids.
- [Haunted House Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/haunted-house-name-generator.html): Haunted house names for Halloween attractions, school fairs, ghost tours and games: grand mansions, family frights, scary attractions and abandoned places.
- [Black Cat Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/black-cat-name-generator.html): Black cat names and Halloween pet names for cats and dogs: spooky, cute, grand and gothic, or named after food, with a costume if you like.
- [Coven Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/coven-name-generator.html): Coven names for witches in D&D, stories and games: covens named for a place or the moon, darker covenants and cosy circles, with a motto if you like.
- [Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/witch-name-generator.html): Witch names for stories, games and Halloween: fairy-tale crones, hedge witches, modern witches and funny costume names, with epithets and familiars.
- [Vampire Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/vampire-name-generator.html): Vampire names in four styles: gothic aristocrats, Old World nobles, ancient Romans and modern vampires. Full names, titles like Count, or first names.
- [Ghost Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/ghost-name-generator.html): Ghost names in the style of real hauntings (the Grey Lady, the Drummer of the Old Mill), restless Victorian spirits, and friendly little ghosts.
- [Zombie Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/zombie-name-generator.html): Zombie names, from funny shambling ones (Groaning Gary) to grim undead titles, plus names for the zombie virus behind the outbreak.
- [Werewolf Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/werewolf-name-generator.html): Werewolf names from real names that mean wolf, like Faolan (little wolf), Ylva (she-wolf) and Rudolf (famous wolf), with their meanings and a pack to run with.
- [Swamp Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/swamp-witch-name-generator.html): Swamp witch and hag names from folklore: Granny Nettle Bogwort, Delphine Murkwater of the bayou, Maud Reedwick of the fens, with an epithet.
- [Harry Potter Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/harry-potter-witch-name-generator.html): Witch names in the style of the Harry Potter books: everyday British or grand pure-blood first names, with a surname to suit each Hogwarts house.
- [Demon Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/demon-name-generator.html): Demon names with a rank and a domain: new names, or the 72 spirits of the Ars Goetia with their traditional ranks, from King Paimon to Duke Astaroth.
- [Villain Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/villain-name-generator.html): Villain names for stories, games and comics: a sinister title (Doctor, Baron, Countess), an unsettling name like The Clockmaker, or a name with a dark epithet.
- [Event Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/event-name-generator.html): Names for parties, festivals, gigs, fundraisers, tournaments, quiz nights, hen and stag dos and work events, plus how to check a name is free.
- [Spell Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/spell-name-generator.html): Spell names for D&D, stories and games, by school of magic: curses, charms, hexes and wards, with a one-line effect if you want one.

## Fantasy

- [Tiefling Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/tiefling-name-generator.html): Tiefling names the D&D way: infernal names passed down a bloodline, or virtue names like Hope and Torment that a tiefling chooses to live up to.
- [Dragonborn Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/dragonborn-name-generator.html): Dragonborn names the D&D way: the clan name first as a mark of honour, then the personal name, plus the childhood names dragonborn use among their clutchmates.
- [Halfling Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/halfling-name-generator.html): Halfling names for D&D: a homely given name, a family name that began as a nickname (Thistledown, Puddlefoot) and a nickname of their own.
- [Gnome Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/gnome-name-generator.html): Gnome names for D&D: a bouncy personal name, a clan name and a nickname, the three names gnomes use with outsiders, chosen because they're the most fun to say.
- [Elf Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/elf-name-generator.html): Elf names in three styles: real elves from Tolkien's books, D&D-style names, and original fantasy names. Male, female and gender-neutral.
- [Half-Elf Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/half-elf-name-generator.html): Half-elf names for D&D: an elven first name with a human surname, a human name with an elven family name, or fully one or the other.
- [Dwarf Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/dwarf-name-generator.html): Dwarf names with a clan to match: mountain clans of iron and stone, hill clans of ale and hearth, or the old "son of" style. Male and female.
- [Dragon Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/dragon-name-generator.html): Dragon names for fire, frost, storm, earth, shadow, sea and venom dragons, harsh or sleek, with an epithet if you want one: "Vharuzul the Ashen".
- [Wizard Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/wizard-name-generator.html): Wizard names for any school of magic: Aldous the Grey, Hester of Greymere, Archmage Ottilie. Male and female, with epithets for the eight D&D schools.
- [Orc Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/orc-name-generator.html): Orc names that sound like a fist on a table, with a deed-name, nickname or clan: Murzag Skullsplitter, Ushra the Unkillable. Male and female.
- [Skyrim Orc Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/skyrim-orc-name-generator.html): Generate Skyrim orc names the way the game builds them: a first name plus gro- (son of) or gra- (daughter of) and a parent's name, like Urag gro-Shub.
- [Warhammer Orc Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/warhammer-orc-name-generator.html): Ork and orc names for Warhammer 40,000, the Old World and Age of Sigmar, with titles, clans and nicknames: Big Mek Skabnik 'Eadbanga of da Deathskulls.
- [World of Warcraft Orc Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/wow-orc-name-generator.html): World of Warcraft orc names that fit the game's name rules, plus an earned surname or a Horde clan for your character's story. Male and female.
- [LOTR Orc Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/lotr-orc-name-generator.html): Orc names in Tolkien's style for Mordor orcs, Uruk-hai of Isengard and goblins of the Misty Mountains, with a rank or the place they serve.
- [Half-Orc Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/half-orc-name-generator.html): Half-orc names for a character raised among humans, among orcs, or somewhere between, with a surname or deed-name to match. Male and female.
- [Goblin Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/goblin-name-generator.html): Goblin, hobgoblin and bugbear names for D&D: snappy goblin names with an epithet, disciplined hobgoblin names with a rank, and lumbering bugbear names.
- [Kobold Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/kobold-name-generator.html): Kobold names for D&D: short, yippy names like Ixik and Snarf, with an optional job title for the trap-setter or dragon-feeder of the tribe.
- [Lizardfolk Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/lizardfolk-name-generator.html): Lizardfolk names for D&D: hissing Draconic-style names, or the plain descriptive names a tribe gives for a deed or trait, like Swims-Deep or Stormeye.
- [Githyanki Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/githyanki-name-generator.html): Githyanki names for D&D and Baldur's Gate 3: harsh, clipped names split by an apostrophe, like Lae'zel, with an optional rank such as kith'rak or gish.
- [Fantasy Town Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/fantasy-town-name-generator.html): Fantasy town and village names built the way real English place names are, for farming villages, fishing ports, mining towns, abbeys, market towns and more.
- [Fantasy Country Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/fantasy-country-name-generator.html): Fantasy country and kingdom names in six styles, from elvish realms and Norse jarldoms to Latin empires and island thalassocracies, with or without a title.
- [Swamp Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/swamp-witch-name-generator.html): Swamp witch and hag names from folklore: Granny Nettle Bogwort, Delphine Murkwater of the bayou, Maud Reedwick of the fens, with an epithet.
- [D&D Fantasy Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/dnd-fantasy-name-generator.html): D&D character names for every common race, with a family or clan name, or a whole random party: a dwarf, a tiefling, a halfling and a dragonborn at once.
- [Path of Exile Witch Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/path-of-exile-witch-name-generator.html): Path of Exile Witch names with an epithet to match your Ascendancy: Necromancer, Elementalist, Occultist, or PoE 2's Infernalist and Blood Mage.
- [Funny Wizard Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/funny-wizard-name-generator.html): Silly wizard names for comic fantasy, parody and light-hearted D&D: Gloop the Magnificent, Mumblespark Glitterbeard, Sir Wobblebink the Spellslinger.
- [High Elf Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/high-elf-name-generator.html): High elf names with a family name built from Quenya, the High-elven tongue, and what it means: Saelwen Isillótë, "Moonflower". Male and female.
- [Wood Elf Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/wood-elf-name-generator.html): Wood elf names with a family name built from Sindarin, and what it means: Fenric Erynloth, "Woodflower". For rangers, druids and forest folk. Male and female.
- [Dark Elf Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/dark-elf-name-generator.html): Dark elf and drow names with a noble house and a title: Matron Mother Quenira of House Mal'Morr. Male and female.
- [Clan Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/clan-name-generator.html): Clan names for fantasy families and gaming teams: Highland-style clans with a motto or war cry, tribes like the Howling Elk, and gaming clans with a tag.
- [Demon Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/demon-name-generator.html): Demon names with a rank and a domain: new names, or the 72 spirits of the Ars Goetia with their traditional ranks, from King Paimon to Duke Astaroth.

- [Fantasy City Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/fantasy-city-name-generator.html): Fantasy city names for capitals, fortresses, ports, northern holds, ancient ruins and river towns, with an epithet if you want one: "the City of Bells".
- [Angel Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/angel-name-generator.html): Angel names from scripture and tradition with their Hebrew meanings, or new ones in the same style, with a choir, a domain or an epithet.
- [Alien Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/alien-name-generator.html): Alien names that sound like they come from a real species: clicking insectoids, liquid-voiced aquatics, beings named like Hums-at-Dawn, and galactic nobility.
- [Fairy Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/fairy-name-generator.html): Fairy names from folklore: flower fairies like Thistledown, lords and ladies of the Seelie and Unseelie Courts, and household sprites like Hob o' the Hearth.
- [Fairy Town Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/fairy-town-name-generator.html): Fairy town and village names from folklore: homes under the hill, hollows in the wood, fairy rings and the great courts of the fae.
- [Elven Sword Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/elven-sword-name-generator.html): Elven sword names built from Tolkien's Sindarin and Quenya, each with its real meaning, plus the famous blades of the legends: Glamdring, Orcrist, Andúril.
- [Hobbit Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/hobbit-name-generator.html): Hobbit names in Tolkien's style: plain Shire names ending in -o, grand Took-style names, Buckland names like Meriadoc, and flower names for girls.
- [LOTR Wizard Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/lotr-wizard-name-generator.html): Wizard names in the style of the Istari of Middle-earth: a colour, an Elvish name built from real Sindarin with its meaning, and a deed.
- [Game of Thrones Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/game-of-thrones-name-generator.html): Game of Thrones names by region of Westeros: a noble with a new house, a bastard with the right surname (Snow, Sand, Rivers), or Valyrian and Free Folk.
- [Elden Ring Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/elden-ring-name-generator.html): Elden Ring names in FromSoftware's style: a Tarnished name, or a boss-worthy title like Godrick the Grafted or Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon.
- [Monster Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/monster-name-generator.html): Monster names for stories, games and Halloween: grim beasts from under the bed, the swamp, the sea and the mountains, or funny, friendly monsters for kids.
- [Spell Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/spell-name-generator.html): Spell names for D&D, stories and games, by school of magic: curses, charms, hexes and wards, with a one-line effect if you want one.

## Folklore

- [Game of Thrones Sword Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/game-of-thrones-sword-name-generator.html): Game of Thrones style sword names to suit a great house, from northern wolves to Ironborn reavers: Ashsister, a Valyrian steel longsword.
- [Superhero Name Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/posts/superhero-name-generator.html): Superhero names in the classic comic-book shapes: an adjective and a noun, a something-Man or -Woman, a title like Captain or Doctor, or a single bold word.

## Name tools

Free tools for lists of names; lists stay in the browser and can be shared as a link.

- [Spin the Wheel](https://thenamegenerators.com/spin-the-wheel.html): Spin a wheel of names to pick one at random.
- [Random Name Picker](https://thenamegenerators.com/random-name-picker.html): Draw one name, like a card from a hat.
- [Raffle / Pick a Winner](https://thenamegenerators.com/raffle-picker.html): Numbered tickets, one winner or several.
- [Secret Santa Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/secret-santa-generator.html): Draws pairs so nobody gets themselves.
- [Team Generator](https://thenamegenerators.com/team-generator.html): Splits a list into even, random teams.
